title: Chapter 8: ASGI Adapter
description: Implements ASGI 3.0 compatibility over the native batch architecture. ASGI apps (FastAPI, Litestar, Starlette) run on Vertebra. Consolidates asgi-adapter, asgi-core-adapter, and asgi-extension-support. ASGI is the slow path (~88k RPS ceiling) due to unavoidable protocol overhead: per-request scope, receive, send, and coroutine scheduling.
performance_gate: Basic ASGI echo app must sustain >= 80,000 req/s in wrk benchmark on same hardware as native batch gate. ASGI protocol overhead is structural; parity with WSGI is not expected.
gates: ASGI scope dict conforms to ASGI 3.0 HTTP Connection Scope specification
ReceiveChannel delivers http.request then http.disconnect in correct sequence
SendCollector assembles VertebraResponse correctly from http.response.start and http.response.body messages
asyncio.TaskGroup drives the batch (no bare create_task calls in runner)
FastAPI hello-world mountable via app.mount and returns correct response
Litestar hello-world mountable via app.mount and returns correct response
